capabilities.title: AI-First Delivery
capabilities.text: I work AI-first. I set up and run scheduled AI agents for daily work summaries and follow-up reminders, and use AI for meeting minutes, follow-up emails, searching Jira and Confluence, and creating and updating tickets and pages. I review all AI output before it goes out. I also built this website with Claude Code.

capabilities.title: Multi-Market Delivery
capabilities.text: Worked across CEE/SEE markets: a five-market webshop migration, a Slovenian webshop under EU VAT rules, and readiness for a regional fintech expansion under central bank and financial regulation.

capabilities.title: Stakeholder & Client Management
capabilities.text:
Managing client expectations and maintaining transparent communication
between business and technical teams. Experienced in facilitating workshops, sprint reviews, and steering meetings to align deliverables with business goals.

capabilities.title: Agile Cross-Functional Delivery
capabilities.text: Apply Scrum and Kanban to plan sprints, manage backlogs, and coordinate development teams and external vendors through testing and release, with Jira dashboards and JQL filters for status meetings and client reporting.
